sourceBindings.text: A mineral soil texture class, a clay-amended teaching container and a tomato potting blend are different things. Read the trainer's material specification and its mass or volume basis before calculating or mixing.

Explain the distinct functions and limits of clay mineral soil, compost, perlite and a phosphorus source; identify whether a recipe is by mass or volume and calculate amounts only from a supplied documented specification.

Under a trainer, identify three real soil samples by feel, select the confirmed clay sample, then measure, mix and assess its separate teaching-container amendment to an announced specification; treat the source's approximate 1 part compost to 2 parts soil as an unverified example, not a general recipe.

Individually calculate and make a 5 kg tomato potting product to the trainer's documented ingredient, proportion, moisture/weight-tolerance and quality specification; check uniformity, final mass, packaging, label and the agronomic reason for each authorized component.

sourceBindings.text: Mark which figures in the three source contexts are volume, mass, unspecified or a finished-product mass. On a blank trainer card, calculate symbolic ingredient masses for 5 kg and explain why a 1:2 volume ratio is not 1:2 by weight.
Under a trainer, perform every item in the three-sample clay-container process card, measure according to an approved ratio basis, mix and clean the station.
Under a trainer, read the signed 5 kg specification, calculate and weigh each approved component, mix evenly, weigh the net product, bag/seal and label it with true ingredients.
Accept correct algebra and explicitly missing data; reject an invented compost/perlite/bone-meal recipe.

This is practice in reading specifications and explaining decisions. No actual batch, measurement, trainer signature or practical pass is supplied by this screen. Real work requires the trainer’s documented specification and individual observation.

sourceBindings.text: mineral loam
A sand/silt/clay texture class, not a promised potting recipe or nutrient result.
growing medium
The material supporting container roots, with physical air/water properties and managed nutrients.
compost
Decomposed organic material with variable maturity, nutrients and soluble salts.
perlite
A light porous physical ingredient used to change air and water behaviour, not a nutrient fertilizer.
bone meal
A processed animal-derived phosphorus source, added only when a test-based specification justifies it.
ratio by volume
Parts measured as volume, such as litres; cannot be treated as the same numerical ratio by mass without density data.
ratio by mass
Parts measured by weight; for a 5 kg total, component mass equals 5 kg times its approved mass fraction.
tolerance
The trainer-approved acceptable deviation from the specified finished net mass, not a guessed number.
